about: Price updates verified against each vendor's own pricing page, help center, or announcement. kind=vendor-change means the vendor announced a change on that date; kind=listing-update means our listed price was out of date and we corrected it on that date (the vendor may have changed it earlier). dir is relative to the price we previously listed.

entries.name: Jasper AI
entries.note: Jasper's cheapest plan is now Pro. There is no free plan, only a 7-day trial.

entries.name: Zoom
entries.note: Workplace Pro now costs more than the price we listed. The free Basic plan (40-minute meetings) still exists.

entries.name: QuickBooks Online
entries.note: Simple Start lists at $38/month, and promos sometimes cut that for the first 3 months. The cheaper QuickBooks Lite and QuickBooks Free are separate products.

entries.name: Ahrefs
entries.note: Ahrefs now has a $29/month Starter plan, billed monthly only. $129 is the Lite plan.

entries.name: WordPress.com
entries.note: The $45 we listed is the Commerce plan. Paid plans actually start at Personal, and there is also a free plan.

entries.name: ActiveCampaign
entries.note: This is the Starter price for fewer than 1,000 contacts. It rises as your list grows.

entries.name: Semrush
entries.note: The old Pro plan at $139.95 has been replaced by the SEO plan. Semrush also has a limited free tier.

entries.name: Shopify
entries.note: The $39 we listed is the monthly-billing rate. Paying yearly costs $29/month.

entries.name: Slack
entries.note: The $8.75 we listed is the monthly-billing rate. There is also a free plan.

entries.name: Claude
entries.note: Paying yearly ($200 upfront) works out to $17/month.

entries.name: Runway
entries.note: The free plan comes with 125 one-time credits.

entries.name: ChatGPT
entries.note: ChatGPT Go, at $8/month in the US, is now the cheapest paid plan.

entries.name: Google Gemini
entries.note: Google AI Plus is a cheaper paid tier that sits below AI Pro.

entries.name: QuickBooks Online
entries.to: Higher renewal prices for Essentials, Plus and Advanced
entries.note: Intuit raised monthly prices for Essentials, Plus and Advanced on renewals from August 1, 2026. Free, Lite, Ledger and Simple Start stayed the same.

entries.name: GitHub Copilot
entries.note: GitHub moved every Copilot plan to AI Credits billing. Base plan prices did not change: Pro is still $10/month.

entries.name: Webflow
entries.note: Webflow simplified its site plans and raised Basic. The static page limit doubled to 300.

entries.name: CapCut
entries.note: CapCut says its previous pricing is no longer offered to new subscribers. A CapCut article lists Pro at $19.99/month or $179.99/year, but prices vary by region and platform, so check the in-app price.
